title: InstalledPackage
description: Information about a package installed in the routine execution environment.

sourceRepository.description: Output only. The source repository from which this package was installed. Populated only when the package was installed from an additional package repository. E.g. 'https://my-region-python.pkg.dev/my-project/my-repo/simple'

name.description: Output only. The name of the installed package.

version.description: Output only. The version of the installed package.
